in_text_mentions: niversity Hospital, Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, due to delayed speech and language development. She was born to first-degree consanguineous parents and was diagnosed as having bilateral severe to profound SNHL and fitted with bilateral hearing aids at the age of nine months. However, no clear benefits were detected from using hearing aids on follow-ups. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed complete corpus callosum agenesis (Figure 1). In addition, whole-exome sequencing revealed an LRP2 gene mutation, confirming the diagnosis of DBS. At the age of 18 months, her IQ test score was 75.
